$comment: The suites that EXECUTE each skills/*/examples/*.sauce.ts on an engine, beyond skills:check's compile and command lines, and the examples nothing runs yet, with why. skills:check (docs/scripts/example-programs.mjs) fails an example in neither list, an entry that is not an example, and a suite that does not exist, does not name the example, or is not one CI runs. Kept here, not in skills/, because the skills ship.

compileOnly.sauce-globals/examples/globals.sauce.ts: compiled, and its token-write lowering pinned, by globals.mts; no suite executes it
compileOnly.sauce-intents/examples/cross-chain.sauce: compiled by intents.mts, which pins on which chain each name resolves; no suite fulfils the intent it opens
compileOnly.sauce-protocols/examples/protocols.sauce: compiled by protocols.mts for chains with and without PancakeSwap V3; no suite executes it
executed by sdk/test/std/remote/evm.e2e.test.ts over each bridge's own contracts, which needs a Router no release publishes yet, so CI skips it
compileOnly.sauce-script/examples/twap.sauce.ts: compiled by skills:check and by the MCP sauce_compile test; no suite executes it
compileOnly.sauce-solana/examples/solana.sauce.ts: compiled by solana.mts, which checks its account manifest; no suite runs it in LiteSVM
compileOnly.sauce-solana/examples/token-2022.sauce.t: compiled by solana.mts, which checks its accounts; no suite runs it in LiteSVM
compileOnly.sauce-swaps/examples/swap-leg.sauce.ts: compiled by swaps.mts for Base and Arbitrum; no suite executes it
